dedupe_keys.name: data for estimation of charging demand for electric vehicles by discrete choice models and numerical simulations application to a case study in turin

description: Data for "Estimation of charging demand for electric vehicles by discrete choice models and numerical simulations: Application to a case study in Turin is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Lorenzo Sica, Francesco Deflorio (Politecnico di Torino). The data collected include model imputs presented in the paper “Estimation of Charging Demand for Electric Vehicles by Discrete Choice Models and Numerical Simulations: Application to a Case Study in Turin.” In addition to the datasets of model attributes and parameters, a shapefile containing the zoning of the study area and the major outputs presented ... Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
